# Step 1: Review and serve your order

## Read the exercise issue

This is the live version of the same one-step exercise. Read the assigned issue and drink criteria in this canvas. Staff provide the real PR and exact revision; you never need a terminal or an external editor.

## Inspect in the App

Use the authentic native PR views inside the Copilot App to inspect Summary, Changes, and Checks. Compare every menu field and confirm only the ordered drink was added. The copied details in this canvas help you compare, but opening them does not certify a live review.

Until the native navigation integration is available, ask staff to open the assigned PR in the App. If trusted review observation is unavailable, stop here; do not substitute rehearsal clicks or a GitHub.com visit.

## Check your order

Choose Refresh verified review to read trusted view evidence and recheck the assigned revision. This is separate from Refresh progress, which only reads saved state. After all three views verify, answer the price, serving-style, and one-drink scope checkpoint. Your own answers are required.

## Approve, then verify serving

Choose Approve reviewed change only when the proposal is correct. Approval records a real review decision, not a merge. An authorized operator must separately merge the assigned PR. Choose Verify merged menu to confirm the resulting app data.

## View the app result

Your app result and the House menu show the drink after its merged menu has been verified. The canvas distinguishes approval, serving, and event result recording. A served drink is not proof that an issue comment or leaderboard submission succeeded.

When event finalization succeeds, the final result in the canvas shows the accepted handle, score, rank, and learning summary. The assigned issue receives the corresponding confirmed update. This is the end of Step 1; there is no next lesson.

## Recover without resetting

If serving succeeds but finalization is unavailable, the menu stays visible and the event result remains pending. Use Retry result with this same run after staff restore the service. Do not create a replacement run or claim a score before acceptance. Hints and retries never reduce your score.
